title: pandorea australis subsp. meonantha
intro: Pandorea australis subsp. meonantha, commonly known as the Australian Wonga Vine or Meonantha, is a flowering vine native to Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pandorea australis subsp. meonantha include antioxidant and antispasmodic effects, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. Bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic properties.
